There are only three days left (!) until the deadline for submitting applications for the showcase and indie pitch at WN Conference Cyprus ’26
Published by
Alexander Semenov
Tags:
WN Cyprus 26
,
wnconf
Both applications can be submitted until September 11, inclusive.
From September 17 to 18, the largest industrial business conference on the island —
WN
— will take place in Limassol. It will feature the following events:
Developer exhibition;
Indie pitch.
Any team that has the following can participate in both, while also receiving a free ticket to the conference:
A working game build (at least a vertical slice);
Gameplay video;
Game presentation.
To participate, simply submit an application: here for the
exhibition
, and here for the
pitch
.
The key is not to delay. The application submission deadline is literally in a couple of days.
Importantly, this time the exhibition is sponsored by GEM Capital. Their representatives will have the opportunity to thoroughly review all projects.
Let’s recall that GEM Capital has helped finance games such as Atomic Heart, Replaced, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous, Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era, and many others.
